_comment: Config for the cross-repo structural-overlap audit (scripts/overlap/). This is the FOURTH conformance axis: beyond org-ruleset drift, the per-repo scorer, and the drift gate, it asks 'is the same structure copy-pasted across repos that should import a shared package instead?'. Two tools: jscpd (Type-1/2/3 clone discovery — renamed vars still match; the measure) and ast-grep (structural rules seeded from what discovery finds; the enforcement). CI checks the `repos` out read-only next to each other and runs both. Product repos are never wired to this; it is enforced from here.
_reposNote: The 'library' set, where 'shared code should be imported, not copied' is the governing rule — every bounded-systems repo this session has access to, except claude-box. claude-box (an app repo with its own internal daemon boilerplate, and a deliberately vendored guest-room mirror) is intentionally out of scope — its duplication is a different, internal concern. Widening further to the rest of the org is tracked in conformance#18; it needs those repos added to this session/CI's checkout access first.

jscpd._maxDuplicationNote: Fail the audit if the overall duplicated-line ratio exceeds this. Current baseline across the widened library set (adds verify + .mjs, conformance#18) is ~2.32%; the budget sits above it so it passes today but catches a regression.

crossRepoAllowlist.reason: trellis/check/lattice.ts and trellis-kit/mod.ts both carry the same DFS cycle-detection helper. This clone is DELIBERATE and permanent, not a pending extraction: lattice.ts runs sealed in a Nix derivation (`deno run --no-remote`, no JSR fetch), so it cannot import the kit — it must mirror it. The kit is canonical; lattice.ts is its hermetic executor. The mirror is kept faithful by trellis/check/lattice_test.ts, which asserts (in ordinary CI, where the network is allowed) that lattice.ts's helpers equal the kit's findCycles/findMultiContractPairs. Keep this entry.

_crossRepoAllowlistNote: A cross-repo clone is a governance smell (two repos re-implementing the same structure). Any cross-repo clone whose {repoA,repoB} pair is NOT allowlisted here FAILS the audit. Entries are acknowledged, reviewable exceptions — each should name why it exists and, ideally, the plan to retire it. The claude-box↔guest-room vendored mirror does not appear here because claude-box is out of `repos` scope.
